tools.name: Search
tools.description: Live, structured data from 50+ specialized providers in one call. Call this tool whenever an answer depends on facts that change over time or that you should not state from memory. A few examples among many more: market and crypto prices, wallets and DeFi, company records and financials, SEC filings

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "Search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
